dialogues.jp: 「おはよ」
dialogues.en: "Mornin'."
dialogues.text: "Mornin'."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「おはよう……じ〜」
dialogues.en: "Good mor....jiii~."
dialogues.text: "Good mor....jiii~."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「朝からわけのわからん擬音が飛び出すとは
　……相当元気みたいだな」
dialogues.en:
"Making unintelligible sounds at this time in the morning...
you must be feeling especially chipper."
dialogues.text:
"Making unintelligible sounds at this time in the morning...
you must be feeling especially chipper."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「どんな元気さですかそれは！」
dialogues.en: "What do you mean by that?!"
dialogues.text: "What do you mean by that?!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「そんな元気さだ。……おっ、今朝は、俺のも
　用意してあるんだな」
dialogues.en:
"Looks like I've just been proven right. ...Ooh, you
remembered to prepare my portion today."
dialogues.text:
"Looks like I've just been proven right. ...Ooh, you
remembered to prepare my portion today."

dialogues.jp: テーブルに着き、早速トーストをパクつく。
dialogues.en: I chowed down on my slice of toast quickly.
dialogues.text: I chowed down on my slice of toast quickly.

dialogues.en: "So what's wrong?"
dialogues.text: "So what's wrong?"

dialogues.jp: 俺の顔をじとっと見つめる音夢に｛たず／訊｝ねる。
dialogues.en:
Feeling uncomfortable at Nemu's staring at me, I posed her a
question.
dialogues.text:
Feeling uncomfortable at Nemu's staring at me, I posed her a
question.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……最近、白河さんと仲いいらしいですね」
dialogues.en:
"...Recently, you've been awfully friendly with
Shirakawa-san, haven't you."
dialogues.text:
"...Recently, you've been awfully friendly with
Shirakawa-san, haven't you."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うっ……ごくん」
dialogues.en: "Uuuhh.. *swig*"
dialogues.text: "Uuuhh.. *swig*"

dialogues.jp: コーヒーで流し込み、何とか息をつく。
dialogues.en: My swallowing of my coffee almost went down the wrong way.
dialogues.text: My swallowing of my coffee almost went down the wrong way.

dialogues.jp:
「な、何だよ、急に。だいたいだなあ、何でそ
　んな事……」
dialogues.en: "W, what, so fast? How do you know that..."
dialogues.text: "W, what, so fast? How do you know that..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「呆れた。知らないんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Surprising. You didn't know?"
dialogues.text: "Surprising. You didn't know?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「何を？」
dialogues.en: "Know what?"
dialogues.text: "Know what?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「学園で、すっかり噂になってるんですよ」
dialogues.en:
"You two are the topic of every piece of gossip around
school recently."
dialogues.text:
"You two are the topic of every piece of gossip around
school recently."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うっ……ごくん」
dialogues.en: "Uuuhh... *swig*"
dialogues.text: "Uuuhh... *swig*"

dialogues.jp:
コーヒーで流し込む。何で、ホットを２口で消
費せにゃならんのだ。
dialogues.en:
I took another large gulp of coffee. I'd almost finished the
entire hot cup in two swigs.
dialogues.text:
I took another large gulp of coffee. I'd almost finished the
entire hot cup in two swigs.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ねえ、兄さん……」
dialogues.en: "Hey, brother..."
dialogues.text: "Hey, brother..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.jp:
空になったカップの底を寂しく見つめる。音夢
の視線から逃れるように。
dialogues.en:
I stared at the bottom of the cup to avoid eye contact with
Nemu.
dialogues.text:
I stared at the bottom of the cup to avoid eye contact with
Nemu.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「白河さんのこと、好きなの？」
dialogues.en: "Do you like Shirakawa-san?"
dialogues.text: "Do you like Shirakawa-san?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Uuuhh... gah, bitter..."
dialogues.text: "Uuuhh... gah, bitter..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「もう、パンは食べ終わってるじゃない」
dialogues.en: "Geez, You haven't even finished your bread yet..."
dialogues.text: "Geez, You haven't even finished your bread yet..."

dialogues.jp:
パンも食べ終わり、コーヒーも飲み終わって、
つまりは、俺はここに座っている必要がない。
dialogues.en:
Now that I've finished my bread and drank my coffee, there's
no reason for me to be sitting here anymore.
dialogues.text:
Now that I've finished my bread and drank my coffee, there's
no reason for me to be sitting here anymore.

dialogues.jp: けれど、立ち去るのはためらわれた。
dialogues.en:
I quickly stood up and tried to escape the situation as
quickly as I could.
dialogues.text:
I quickly stood up and tried to escape the situation as
quickly as I could.

dialogues.jp:
「……どうなんだろうな。確かに、最近、一緒
　に居る事が多いけど……」
dialogues.en:
"...I don't know. We just happen to be involved in a lot of
matters that we were similarly interested in..."
dialogues.text:
"...I don't know. We just happen to be involved in a lot of
matters that we were similarly interested in..."

dialogues.jp:
好きとか嫌いとかって話になったら……正直、
どうなのか分からない。
dialogues.en:
I don't really want to say that I do in front of Nemu... but
honestly, I don't really know myself.
dialogues.text:
I don't really want to say that I do in front of Nemu... but
honestly, I don't really know myself.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ね、兄さん」
dialogues.en: "You know, brother."
dialogues.text: "You know, brother."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Mm?"
dialogues.text: "Mm?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「好きになっちゃったなら、私はそれでいいよ」
dialogues.en: "Whether or not you've fallen in love, that's fine with me."
dialogues.text: "Whether or not you've fallen in love, that's fine with me."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「どこまで行ったって、兄さんは私の兄さんだ
　し、私は、兄さんの妹なんだから」
dialogues.en:
"No matter which route you'd take, you'd always be my
brother, and I'd always be your sister."
dialogues.text:
"No matter which route you'd take, you'd always be my
brother, and I'd always be your sister."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「バッカ」
dialogues.en: "Iiiidiot."
dialogues.text: "Iiiidiot."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うっ……な、何よ〜！」
dialogues.en: "W....whaaat? Geez!"
dialogues.text: "W....whaaat? Geez!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「いいから、さっさとメシ食えよな。遅れるぜ？
　俺は、もう一杯、コーヒー飲んでるからよ」
dialogues.en:
"Whatever, hurry up and finish your breakfast already,
you're going to be late. I'd go make another cup of coffee."
dialogues.text:
"Whatever, hurry up and finish your breakfast already,
you're going to be late. I'd go make another cup of coffee."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "...Okay."
dialogues.text: "...Okay."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「おはようさんです〜」
dialogues.en: "Good morning~"
dialogues.text: "Good morning~"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「おはようございます」
dialogues.en: "Good morning."
dialogues.text: "Good morning."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「おはよ……う」
dialogues.en: "Mornin...g."
dialogues.text: "Mornin...g."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あ、いやあ……その、マスク取れたんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Ah, just... you've taken off your mask?"
dialogues.text: "Ah, just... you've taken off your mask?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「はい。やっぱり夜ぐっすり眠ったら、調子が
　良くなりました」
dialogues.en:
"Yep! I had a good night's sleep yesterday, and I'm feeling
much better now."
dialogues.text:
"Yep! I had a good night's sleep yesterday, and I'm feeling
much better now."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そ、そりゃ良かった」
dialogues.en: "T, that's good."
dialogues.text: "T, that's good."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
（くっ……音夢が変な事言ったせいで、妙に意
　識しちまうじゃねえか……）
dialogues.en:
"(Damnit... Nemu's weird talk just now's really affecting
me, I'm seeing a lot more about Kotori than usual...)"
dialogues.text:
"(Damnit... Nemu's weird talk just now's really affecting
me, I'm seeing a lot more about Kotori than usual...)"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
（色つやのいい唇とか、ぱっちりと長い｛まつげ／睫毛｝と
　か、すっと通った鼻筋とか、そういうのが気
　になっちまうじゃねえか……）
dialogues.en:
"(Those nicely coloured lips, the long eyebrows that seem to
go on forever, that cute, perky little nose...)"
dialogues.text:
"(Those nicely coloured lips, the long eyebrows that seem to
go on forever, that cute, perky little nose...)"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「な、何ですか、赤い顔しちゃって〜……」
dialogues.en: "Y, your face is turning red~"
dialogues.text: "Y, your face is turning red~"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「……ね、熱でもあるんですか？　私の風邪、
　移っちゃいました？」
dialogues.en: "...Uhm, are you feeling hot? Did I pass my cold on to you?"
dialogues.text: "...Uhm, are you feeling hot? Did I pass my cold on to you?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「いやいや、そんなんじゃないんだけど」
dialogues.en: "No no no, that's not it..."
dialogues.text: "No no no, that's not it..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「（くっ……何見つめ合ってんのよ……）」
dialogues.en: "(Kuh... look at them staring at each other like that...)"
dialogues.text: "(Kuh... look at them staring at each other like that...)"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「（やっぱり、ムカツクわね……）」
dialogues.en: "(It's disgusting...)"
dialogues.text: "(It's disgusting...)"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「は、はは……何だよ、音夢。変な顔しちゃっ
　て」
dialogues.en: "Ha, haha... what's wrong, Nemu, your face looks weird."
dialogues.text: "Ha, haha... what's wrong, Nemu, your face looks weird."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「元々です。おほほほ」
dialogues.en: "It's completely natural. O ho ho ho!"
dialogues.text: "It's completely natural. O ho ho ho!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あははは」
dialogues.en: "A ha ha ha."
dialogues.text: "A ha ha ha."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「うふふふ」
dialogues.en: "Uhe he he."
dialogues.text: "Uhe he he."

dialogues.jp: 「行こか」
dialogues.en: "Let's go."
dialogues.text: "Let's go."

dialogues.jp: ◆ことりの事◆
dialogues.en: ◆There's Something About Kotori◆
dialogues.text: ◆There's Something About Kotori◆

dialogues.jp:
音夢が妙な事を言ってきた。俺が、ことりの事
を好きなのかどうなのか、とか。
dialogues.en: Nemu asked me something weird; whether I liked Kotori.
dialogues.text: Nemu asked me something weird; whether I liked Kotori.

dialogues.jp:
それが実際のところどっちなのか、俺にも分か
らない。
dialogues.en: In truth, I really didn't know whether I did or not.
dialogues.text: In truth, I really didn't know whether I did or not.

dialogues.jp:
音夢が妙な事を言ったせいなのかどうなのか、
やけにことりを意識してしまう俺であった。
dialogues.en:
Thanks to Nemu's weird implications, I felt stranger than
usual when I met Kotori later.
dialogues.text:
Thanks to Nemu's weird implications, I felt stranger than
usual when I met Kotori later.
